sensors.name: line tracker, brightness in % (in the dark branch)
line tracker, sees black (in the light branch)

control_flow: followInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 % (dim): if the line tracker reads below 90 % curve left 10/30, else if it reads above 90 % curve right 30/10, else call avoidWalls; in bright light: call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: if dim: if the LEFT sensor sees something turn right 20°, else if the RIGHT sensor sees something turn left 20°, else call driveInTheDark; in bright light: call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: if dim drive forward at 30 %; in bright light: call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if the FRONT sensor sees something stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black curve left 10/40; else curve right 40/10.
